description: List the agent runs, live and finished, in the caller's accessible projects, newest first. Each run is one agent in its own sandbox. Returns id (the run's sandbox id), issueId, role, harness, status, instance type, and latest CPU/memory/disk metrics. When more runs match, nextCursor is set: pass it back as cursor, with the same filters, for the next page.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the newest runs

issueId.description: Only the runs of this mission, by its issue id, e.g. SHIP-412

limit.description: Max results (default 50). Narrow with projectId, issueId, role or status before raising it.

role.description: Only the runs of this agent role

status.description: Filter by how the run stands: running, completed (finished), stopped (ended on purpose before it finished), failed, or stale (closed without a report)

name: list_agent_runs

endedAt.description: When the run ended, in epoch milliseconds. Null until the run ends.

status.description: How the agent's run in this sandbox stands. `running`: the agent works now. `completed`: the agent finished its work. `stopped`: something ended the run on purpose before it finished, for example a newer run, a stop of the mission or a person. `failed`: the agent reported a failure, or exited without a report. `stale`: the platform closed the run without a report, after its time limit or after a later attempt replaced it.

title: List agent runs
